10-View Visual IDE & 5 Guided AeroWizards

InstallerStudio.exe pairs a 10-view left navigation sidebar with an in-memory lossless Abstract Syntax Tree (AST). Whenever you change a field in any visual form or wizard, only the targeted key-value line updates while every ; comment, # comment, and @include directive stays intact.

The 10 Workspace Views

  1. Package & Identity: Product name, tagline, 3-part MSI version (Major.Minor.Build), publisher, permanent UpgradeCode GUID, and install scope (machine vs. user).
  2. Destination Files & Folders: Hierarchical Destination Computer folder tree paired with a filtered payload and folder list.
  3. Setup Design (Components): Visual Features -> Sub-Features -> Components -> KeyPaths hierarchy.
  4. Runtimes & Merge Modules: Manage Pre-MSI [Prerequisite.*] runtimes and 64-bit [MergeModule.*] (.msm) libraries.
  5. File Associations & Verbs: Register document extensions (.ext), ProgIds, MIME types, and shell verbs in clean HKMU\Software\Classes or advertised MSI tables.
  6. Shortcuts & Registry: Author Start Menu / Desktop shortcuts and 64-bit registry values.
  7. C++ Wizard Designer: Real-time GDI+ preview of SetupWizard.exe across standard Glass, aerowizard, and autorun16x9 layouts.
  8. MSI.DLL Dialog Designer: Visual 370x270 DLU canvas for relational Windows Installer Dialog and Control SQL tables.
  9. Signing, .MST & .MSP: Configure Dual-Layer Authenticode signing and generate GPO Transforms (.mst) or Patch Packages (.msp).
  10. .RSIP Source (AST): Direct monospace source editor synchronized live with every visual view.

Five Guided Native AeroWizards

  • New Project Assistant (Ctrl+W): Creates a complete .rsip manifest with fresh GUIDs, payload discovery, and shortcuts in five steps.
  • Runtime Prerequisite & .MSM Wizard: Adds curated or custom runtime installers and Merge Modules with automatic exit-code handling.
  • Component & KeyPath Wizard: Guides you through Microsoft's Single-Directory and HKCU profile KeyPath rules.
  • File Association Wizard: Maps document extensions, icons, and shell verbs cleanly to your main executable.
  • Release, Transform (.MST) & Patch (.MSP) Wizard: Builds release artifacts, VPAT 2.5 reports, and binary database diffs.

Essential IDE Keyboard Shortcuts

ShortcutAction
F1Opens RaggieSoftHelp.exe directly to the topic matching your active IDE view via Named Pipe IPC.
Ctrl+WLaunches the 5-step New Project AeroWizard.
F7Runs instbuild.exe --validate and prints structured diagnostics in the bottom console.
F5Compiles the standalone .msi and self-extracting Setup.exe bootstrapper.
F6Compiles a reusable 64-bit Windows Installer Merge Module (.msm).
